label: Reference Resources
desc: Use print or digital resources to determine meaning, syllabication, pronunciation, word origin, and part of speech.

label: Vocabulary in Context
desc: Use contrast, cause-and-effect, and other context clues to clarify word meaning.

label: Greek and Latin Roots
desc: Determine meaning and usage of words built from Grade 7 Greek and Latin roots.

label: Predictions
desc: Make, correct, and confirm predictions using text features, genre characteristics, and structure.

label: Connections Across Texts and Society
desc: Connect a text to experiences, ideas in other texts, and society.

label: Inferences
desc: Make reasonable inferences from explicit and implicit details.

label: Key Ideas
desc: Evaluate details to determine key ideas.

label: Synthesis
desc: Combine information within or across texts to create a new understanding.

label: Text Evidence
desc: Select relevant text evidence that supports an appropriate response.

label: Paraphrase and Summary
desc: Paraphrase and summarize while preserving meaning and logical order.

label: Themes
desc: Infer multiple themes within and across literary texts using evidence.

label: Character and Conflict
desc: Analyze how character qualities influence events and resolution of conflict.

label: Foreshadowing, Suspense, and Plot
desc: Analyze plot elements, including foreshadowing and suspense.

label: Setting
desc: Analyze how setting influences character and plot development.

label: Literary Genres
desc: Recognize characteristics of realistic fiction, adventure, historical fiction, mystery, humor, myth, fantasy, and science fiction.

label: Poetic Structure
desc: Analyze rhyme scheme, meter, punctuation, capitalization, and other graphical elements in poetry.

label: Drama: Dialogue and Staging
desc: Analyze how dialogue and staging develop characters in drama.

label: Informational Thesis and Evidence
desc: Identify and analyze a controlling idea or thesis and its supporting evidence.

label: References and Acknowledgements
desc: Use references and acknowledgements to understand background, sources, and assistance.

label: Informational Organization
desc: Analyze organizational patterns that support topics, categories, and subcategories.

label: Argumentative Claim
desc: Identify the central claim in an argumentative text.

label: Argument Evidence and Alternatives
desc: Explain how evidence and consideration of alternatives support an argument.

label: Intended Audience
desc: Identify the intended audience or reader of an argument.

label: Author’s Purpose and Message
desc: Explain an author’s purpose and message.

label: Structure and Purpose
desc: Analyze how text structure contributes to the author’s purpose.

label: Print and Graphic Features
desc: Analyze how headings, captions, charts, diagrams, and other features achieve a purpose.

label: Figurative Language
desc: Describe how metaphor, personification, and other figurative language achieve a purpose.

label: Subjective and Objective Point of View
desc: Identify subjective and objective point of view and explain the effect.

label: Mood, Voice, and Tone
desc: Analyze how language contributes to mood, voice, and tone.

label: Rhetorical Devices and Logical Fallacies
desc: Distinguish rhetorical devices from logical fallacies and explain their effects.

label: Organize a Coherent Draft
desc: Revise introductions, transitions, paragraph coherence, and conclusions for purposeful structure.

label: Develop Ideas with Details
desc: Develop an engaging idea with specific, relevant facts and details.

label: Revise for Clarity and Style
desc: Revise for clarity, development, organization, style, word choice, and sentence variety.

label: Edit Using Standard English Conventions

label: Verb Tense
desc: Maintain consistent and appropriate verb tense.

label: Conjunctive Adverbs
desc: Use conjunctive adverbs correctly with appropriate punctuation.

label: Prepositions and Agreement
desc: Use prepositions and prepositional phrases correctly and identify their influence on agreement.

label: Pronouns, Including Relative Pronouns
desc: Use clear, correct pronouns, including relative pronouns.

label: Subordinating and Correlative Conjunctions
desc: Use subordinating and correlative conjunctions to form correct relationships.

label: Capitalization
desc: Capitalize proper nouns, abbreviations, initials, acronyms, and organizations.

label: Punctuation
desc: Use commas and other punctuation in complex sentences, transitions, and introductory elements.

label: Spelling and Commonly Confused Words
desc: Use correct spelling and distinguish commonly confused terms.

label: Text-Based Response
desc: Write a response that demonstrates understanding of one or more texts.

label: Informational Composition
desc: Compose an informational text with a clear controlling idea and relevant evidence.

label: Argumentative Composition
desc: Compose an argument with a defensible claim, evidence, reasoning, and attention to alternatives.

label: Correspondence
desc: Compose business or friendly correspondence that states an opinion, complaint, or request.

label: Active Listening and Clarifying Questions
desc: Listen actively, interpret a message, and ask clarifying questions that build on others’ ideas.

label: Complex Oral Instructions
desc: Follow and give complex oral instructions to perform tasks, answer questions, or solve problems.

label: Oral Critique Presentation
desc: Present a critique with effective delivery, organization, and conventions.

label: Discussion and Constructive Feedback
desc: Engage in meaningful discourse and provide and accept constructive feedback.

label: Purposeful Fluency
desc: Adjust reading fluency based on purpose and text.

label: Independent Sustained Reading
desc: Self-select grade-appropriate texts and read independently for a sustained period.

label: Establish a Reading Purpose
desc: Establish a purpose before reading assigned or self-selected texts.

label: Generate Questions
desc: Generate useful questions before, during, and after reading.

label: Create Mental Images
desc: Create mental images to deepen understanding.

label: Monitor and Repair Comprehension
desc: Notice when understanding breaks down and choose an effective repair strategy.

label: Personal Response Connections
desc: Describe personal connections to a variety of sources.

label: Interact with Sources
desc: Use notetaking, annotating, freewriting, or illustrating to interact with a source.

label: Use Newly Acquired Vocabulary
desc: Use newly acquired vocabulary appropriately in a response.

label: Explicit and Implicit Meaning
desc: Discuss and write about explicit and implicit meanings.

label: Register, Vocabulary, Tone, and Voice
desc: Match register, vocabulary, tone, and voice to a speaking or writing situation.

label: Reflect on and Adjust Responses
desc: Revise a response when new evidence changes or refines understanding.

label: Multimodal and Digital Texts
desc: Analyze how words, images, audio, video, and navigation work together in multimodal texts.

label: Plan a First Draft
desc: Select a genre and use planning strategies suited to topic, purpose, and audience.

label: Publish for an Audience
desc: Publish written work in a format appropriate for the intended audience.

desc: Compose personal narratives, fiction, or poetry using genre characteristics and craft.

label: Generate Inquiry Questions
desc: Generate student-selected and teacher-guided questions for inquiry.

label: Develop and Revise a Research Plan

label: Gather Relevant Information
desc: Identify and gather relevant information from a variety of sources.

label: Primary and Secondary Sources
desc: Differentiate between primary and secondary sources.

label: Synthesize Research Sources
desc: Synthesize information from a variety of sources.

label: Paraphrasing and Plagiarism
desc: Distinguish ethical paraphrasing from plagiarism.

label: Evaluate Sources and Faulty Reasoning
desc: Examine reliability, credibility, bias, hyperbole, emotional appeals, and stereotypes.

label: Citations and Ethical Source Use
desc: Display academic citations and use source materials ethically.

label: Present Research Results
desc: Choose an effective written, oral, or multimodal mode to present results.
